lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three high-luminance blobs form a vertical column immediately posterior to the fifth gill slit, with a fourth prominent node located further posterior and ventral to the middle spot, creating a distinct diamond-shaped cluster. Additional spots extend posteriorly in roughly horizontal rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance spots, creating a faint, grid-like arrangement of nodes behind the gill slits.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge is visible across the upper third of the visible flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with light pixels on the superior edge and darker pixels in shadow on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible portion of the pectoral fin displays a dense population of high-luminance blobs, with the highest concentration of smaller spots located near the fin's proximal attachment to the body.
